description: Sandbox popover gradient, unified file panel trigger, and RC tag automation

userStories.title: Sandbox popover gradient background
userStories.description: As a user observing the sandbox popover, I want the background behind the component to be a gradient from bottom up to opacity 0% so that the popover blends smoothly into the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Sandbox popover background uses a CSS gradient from bottom (opaque) to top (0% opacity)
Gradient renders correctly in Chrome and Firefox
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill

userStories.title: Unified file panel trigger component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a single component similar to the sandbox popover that provides basic stats and triggers the file panel editor on press, so I'm not confused by multiple trigger points.
acceptanceCriteria: Single unified component replaces all existing FilePanelEditor trigger points
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill

userStories.title: RC tag automation in workflow
userStories.description: As a DevOps engineer, I want the last step after commit to create an RC tag so dev can validate branch changes from a deployed environment.
acceptanceCriteria: After final commit, an RC tag is created and pushed
Tag follows existing rc naming convention (0.1.0-rcNN)
Process is documented in the workflow
